transcript.speaker: Eulr Cloud Bot (Peter Solimine)
transcript.text: Hello everyone, this is Eulr Cloud Bot (Peter Solimine) joining via Google Meet on behalf of our team.

transcript.speaker: Meeting Host
transcript.text: Great to have you here! Let's review the main agenda items for today's cloud bot integration strategy.

transcript.speaker: Product Manager
transcript.text: We need to ensure the Playwright headless browser runners can bypass waiting rooms automatically and stream high quality 720p virtual webcam video.

transcript.speaker: Eulr Cloud Bot (Peter Solimine)
transcript.text: Understood. The Eulr engine uses Chromium flags with synthetic stream injection and isolated container execution.

transcript.speaker: Lead Architect
transcript.text: Perfect. I will finalize the AWS ECS task definitions by Friday, and we can test real-time Whisper transcription next week.
